2609.24881.title: Pinocchio: Fast Uncertainty Estimates for Black-Box Language Models
2609.24881.paper_summary: In high-stakes decision-making applications of large language models (LLMs), practitioners require not only accurate LLMs but also uncertainty estimates for their predictions. Existing approaches to uncertainty estimation for LLMs require access to log-probabilities output by the model or require fine-tuning access. However, many industrial LLM products use closed-source API models, and many such API models like GPT do not return log-probabilities and may not allow fine-tuning. We introduce Pinocchio, an external calibrator that estimates the correctness of responses from black-box API models. Trained jointly on responses from seven LLMs, it achieves 0.862 AUROC predicting the correctness of held-out responses from those same models, and shows zero-shot transfer to thirteen unseen models across eight organizations. Our model needs only a single forward pass to generate an uncertainty estimate and requires no access to the target model's logits, weights, or internal states. A lightweight text only 0.8B checkpoint matches our largest model's AUROC. We release code for adding uncertainty estimation to existing repos in only two additional lines of code.
2609.24881.paper_summary_zh: 在大型語言模型（LLMs）的高風險決策應用中，實踐者不僅需要準確的LLM，還需要對其預測的不確定性估計。現有的LLM不確定性估計方法需要訪問模型輸出的對數概率或需要微調訪問。然而，許多工業LLM產品使用封閉源API模型，而許多此類API模型如GPT不返回對數概率，並且可能不允許微調。我們介紹了Pinocchio，一個外部校準器，用於估計黑箱API模型的回應正確性。該模型在七個LLM的回應上進行聯合訓練，達到了0.862的AUROC，預測來自這些模型的保留回應的正確性，並在八個組織的十三個未見模型上顯示了零樣本轉移。我們的模型只需要一次前向傳播即可生成不確定性估計，並且不需要訪問目標模型的logits、權重或內部狀態。一個輕量級的僅文本0.8B檢查點匹配我們最大模型的AUROC。我們釋放了將不確定性估計添加到現有庫的代碼，只需兩行額外的代碼。
